title: Cat Water Fountain Stainless Steel: 74oz/2.2L Cat Fountain for Drinking
say: Customers report that their cats love the water fountain, which runs silently and is easy to take apart for cleaning. They appreciate its stainless steel design, find it well worth the money, and say it stays clean. Durability receives mixed feedback - while some say it will last a long time, others report it breaking after three months.
